svg.title: A visible path from intent to evidence
svg.desc: Clarify agrees the target, baseline and scope with one human review. Loop evolves implementation and recorded check evidence. Handoff delivers as-built artifacts and verification for human acceptance. AI judgment remains distinct from measured evidence.
